name: planet-life-root
description: Root package.json to delegate commands to the backend for easy hosting deployment

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const frontendPath=fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')?'frontend/dist':'planet_life/frontend/dist'; const sourceLogo=path.join(frontendPath, 'logo.png'); const destFavicon=path.join(frontendPath, 'favicon.ico'); if(fs.existsSync(sourceLogo) && !fs.existsSync(destFavicon)) fs.copyFileSync(sourceLogo, destFavicon);"
